name: Heiress of Vengeance
overview: Park Ji-young, a chaebol heiress and director, hides her identity to help her struggling husband Kang Do-yoon. Betrayed and abused by him, and threatened by his mistress Kim Bo-ra's arson, she's saved by actor Jeong Woo-bin, who loves her. Ji-young vows divorce and revenge to reclaim herself.
